watch.summary: The creator dramatically condemns himself after accidentally scoring an own goal in Rocket League.

beats.what: The creator yells at himself to be sent to the Gulag as the replay starts.
Goofy cartoonish music plays over the replay of his car awkwardly hitting the ball backward.
The ball enters his own net for an own goal.
He bangs his desk and screams to be sent straight to the Gulag.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Take me to the Gulag right now!
watch.why: The creator's energetic self-loathing combines well with the goofy edit music playing over his obvious mistake. It is a straightforward, relatable gaming fail elevated by high-energy theatrical rage.
